scope: Local BenchmarkDotNet microbenchmark of provider services against fake upstreams; not a production, native-AOT, ARM64 or cache-ROI measurement

measured_identity.description: Isolated performance worktree t3-1c48689d = d778400 + first-package prerequisite v1 + second-wave performance delta. NOT the combined second-wave candidate, not eb13185, not a native or deployed build.

run.job: explicit Short, --runtimes net10.0, one launch, 3 warmup and 3 measured iterations per case
run.host_noise: background agent/MCP processes (~5% CPU) and idle editor/MSBuild processes on an otherwise ~95% idle 12-core host

raw_exports.retention: Raw exports retained outside the repository and identified by these hashes

observations: NuGet 3-name warm 304 allocates 3304 B/op versus 3288 B/op for cold 200 (+16): the 304 path saves no allocation today; exact byte attribution was not isolated.
Only 3 measured samples per case: confidence intervals are wide, especially GitHub 32-name 200, so timing differences are not statistically established.
unmeasured: Retained cache heap (MemoryDiagnoser reports allocation per operation only)
Component-level A/B benefit of any cache change
Native AOT/ARM64 behavior and artifact size
interpretation_limits: This baseline does not justify or authorize a production cache change.
